title: 159. Sort Colors

examples.explanation: The array has two 0s, two 1s, and two 2s. Sorting them in-place places all 0s first, then all 1s, then all 2s.
The array has one each of 0, 1, and 2, arranged in-place in the order 0, 1, 2.

hints: Count 0s, 1s, and 2s in one pass, then overwrite the array (counting sort).
Or use the Dutch national flag: three pointers (low, mid, high) for a single-pass O(1)-space sort.
